name: Desperate Hunger

stealth.note: (master) to feel an odd sense of hunger

description: A skeletally thin spirit appears, weeping as it shoves earth and stones down its throat in an effort to stave off hunger.
disable: DC 36 Deception (master) to convince the spirit it's no longer hungry or DC 38 Occultism (trained) to ritually feed the spirit

generalAbilities.name: Desperate Meal
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet

Effect Creatures within 30 feet are filled with painful hunger and must succeed at a DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw save or feel their stomachs fill with rocks, dirt, and worse, dealing (6d10+20) Piercing Damage damage.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Sickened 2.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Sickened 4, and takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for as long as it's sickened.
